name: Claim Information
_sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 837Q3.I.5010.X223.A1.xml — the institutional counterpart to loops/2300-claim.json (837P's own shared claim subtree). Genuinely different shape, not a copy: CL1 (Institutional Claim Code) replaces nothing (no professional equivalent), SV2 replaces SV1/SV5, no SV1/SV5/CR1/CR2/CR3/QTY/MEA/PS1/2440 (ambulance/spinal/DME/form-identification are professional-only concepts), 2320 gains BOTH MIA and MOA (institutional has separate inpatient/outpatient adjudication segments) and 9 Other-Payer sub-loops (2330A-I, not 837P's 7 A-G) — institutional distinguishes 'Operating Physician' from 'Other Operating Physician' as separate provider roles the professional IG doesn't have. Referenced from 837I's own 2000B/2000C positions via the SAME loopRef mechanism as 837P's 2300-claim.json — see that file's own _sourceRefs for the full duplication-avoidance rationale, and CLAUDE.md's EDI Phase 2 section.

TRIGGER DISCRIMINATORS added (September 2026, found via real-sample 837-to-FHIR-mapping testing — see 2300-claim.json's own note for the general mechanism and rationale): 71=Attending Physician, 72=Operating Physician, 82=Rendering Provider (same code as professional's own Rendering role), 77=Service Facility Location (CONFIRMED directly against a real, unedited sample — databricks-industry-solutions/x12-edi-parser's own CC_837I_EDI.txt used NM1*77 for exactly this role), DN=Referring Provider (same code as professional's own Referring role).

2310C DISCRIMINATOR RESOLVED (named gap closed, later session): originally left undiscriminated because its own real NM1-01 code value couldn't be confirmed with confidence from available web sources at the time (two different unofficial blogs even disagreed with each other — one claiming 'OOP', another claiming '72', both wrong). Resolved by downloading and grepping PyX12's own primary IG map (azoner/pyx12 837Q3.I.5010.X223.A1.xml) directly instead of trusting summarized/blog sources — its own ZZ constraint is unambiguous, and every one of the other five 2310 loops' own valid_codes in that SAME file (71/72/82/77/DN) matched this schema's existing discriminators exactly, cross-validating the source. 'ZZ' (Mutually Defined) is a generic X12 qualifier elsewhere in the standard, but is a specific, deliberate IG choice for this exact loop position — safe and correct as a discriminator here since no sibling in this group shares it.
